reviews.comment: Loved prof Gatson! She is very approachable and will work with you. You have 10 assignments, 4 discussion posts, 4 power point slides, and 2 papers (no tests!). I highly recommend this class because the content is interesting and the material is very manageable
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is soci of community and I did not learn anything about that. I learned about soci of food. She changes the courses she teaches to fit her project about food scarcity, which I do not think is fair to her students. The class criteria is confusing but she is a very fair grader- if you put in the effort, you'll do fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She was a great professor who is passionate about the class and is cares about the students. The assignments were relatively short and were graded sparingly. It's not difficult to get an A. There were no tests or quizzes. The only grades were the write-up assignments and final group project/presentation. Great Professor!
Very boring class. Lectures are long, and grading can be subjective sometimes.

She was a fantastic professor for Popular Culture. I thoroughly enjoyed her class and would take it again if I could. There were 2 papers, 4 discussion questions, and 4 PowerPoint presentations. All of these were very easy; she was an easy grader. This course was an easy A. She was very sweet and approachable!
